components.label: Housing
components.hint: Front wall, depth and clamp block are worked out from the camera and the rack tube.

components.label: Lid
components.hint: Hidden by default so you can see inside. Goes straight on: four pegs press the board, a lip keeps it square.

components.label: Lock bars (2)
components.hint: Slide down from the top over the rail and the lid flange on each side; the tapered rail pulls the lid tight. Pull up by the heads to open.

components.label: Rack clamp cap
components.hint: Two M3 screws pull it onto the rack tube, into inserts in the block on top of the housing.

components.label: Rack tube
components.hint: Not printed: the back end of the rear rack, running sideways (diameter is an ESTIMATE).

components.label: Camera Module 3 Wide
components.hint: Not printed: board, lens and connector, sized from the official Raspberry Pi drawing.

components.label: Window plate
components.hint: Clear plastic plate bonded into the recess in the front.

components.label: Gasket groove
components.hint: The groove for the foam cord, shown as the solid that is cut away.

components.label: Ribbon slot
components.hint: Straight down through the floor, under the connector: the ribbon needs no bend.

components.label: Ribbon
components.hint: Not printed: the flat camera cable.
